After dating for 6 years and married for 2 years, Jake passed away suddenly from a fever last March. Jake and Dia are the only true couple in my eyes. Her friends are saying that I am being selfish making it all about myself and not for the bride, that I should be a true friend and be happy and supportive for her. AITA?
